understanding: I must design Invoke-BridgeSelfDecomposeGate, a mandatory control gate that decides the fate of a large 'bridge-self' parent task after a decomposition attempt: mark it 'decomposed' (and keep it away from the coder) when >=2 valid split atoms were produced with no ingest errors; otherwise either force a decompose-retry (incrementing a retry counter) or, after the budget is exhausted, put the parent on 'held' with reason 'bridge-self-decomposition-invalid'. Code reading revealed three facts the contract states inaccurately: (1) the named setters Update-IdeaStatus / Set-IdeaHoldReason do NOT exist — the canonical API is Set-Idea -Id -Status 'held'|'decomposed' -Reason '<reason>' (lib/backlog-crud.ps1:381, used as Set-Idea ... -Status 'held' throughout driver/81). (2) Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh is DEFINED at the top of driver/86-loop-completion-actions.ps1 but its only CALL site is driver/86-loop-completion-cleanup.ps1:938, inside the cleanup scriptblock where per-task context ($task, $Channel, current_backlog_id, state) is live; the actions blocks run BEFORE cleanup (order in 86-loop-completion.ps1: Critic -> RuntimeChecks -> Project -> Cleanup), so 'after Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh' can only mean the cleanup call site. (3) The dependency crusher-03 field bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest is not yet present in any .ps1, so the gate must tolerate its absence. Test-IsLargeTask (lib/prompt-builder.ps1:553) already returns false for tags 'atom'/'decomposed-child' but NOT 'bridge-self-child', and for main/bridge it needs AcceptanceCount/SubsystemCount/EstimatedTurns/Files — values derivable only from the full idea object, not from (id,tags,channel,scope,taskText) alone.
summary: Add a self-contained, fully try/catch-guarded function Invoke-BridgeSelfDecomposeGate to driver/86-loop-completion-actions.ps1 that (a) evaluates the entry predicate channel=='main' AND scope=='bridge' AND tags exclude 'atom'/'decomposed-child'/'bridge-self-child' AND Test-IsLargeTask==true (loading the idea via Get-IdeaById to supply the counts Test-IsLargeTask needs), (b) on a TRUE predicate reads $state.bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest, computes valid_split_count over created+same-parent-skipped atoms with valid_for_split==true, and (c) returns a structured decision object {action: 'noop'|'decomposed'|'force-decompose-retry'|'held', valid_split_count, retry_count, errors}. The function performs the durable side effects itself (Set-Idea status/reason, Update-State counter, Add-Message 'CRUSHER: ...' logs) but RETURNS the decision so the cleanup call site can enact loop-scoped effects a PowerShell function cannot reach — namely suppressing the coder STATUS:CONTINUE for 'decomposed', or setting $plannerStatus='CONTINUE' plus the force-decompose-retry flag for the retry path. Insert exactly one guarded call right after line 938 in the cleanup block, passing the current task's id/tags/channel/scope/taskText and the freshly read state. Map the contract's non-existent Update-IdeaStatus/Set-IdeaHoldReason onto the real Set-Idea -Status -Reason. Treat a missing/stale/parent-mismatched ingest as 'no valid split' so the gate degrades to the retry path instead of throwing. Preserve UTF-8 BOM; keep the whole gate inside try/catch so it can never wedge completion or block DONE.

decision_atoms.statement: Define Invoke-BridgeSelfDecomposeGate inside driver/86-loop-completion-actions.ps1, but place its single invocation immediately after the Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh call at driver/86-loop-completion-cleanup.ps1:938 — not inside an actions scriptblock.
decision_atoms.reason: The actions blocks execute BEFORE cleanup (86-loop-completion.ps1 order), and the only place where Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh is actually CALLED — and where the per-task id/channel/scope/state are in scope — is the cleanup block. A bare call at file scope in actions.ps1 would fire at dot-source time, not per task.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: The contract's Files list names only actions.ps1, so this requires a one-line edit to a second file (cleanup.ps1). I accept the minimal cross-file insert because the explicit 'call after Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh' instruction and the acceptance tests outrank the under-specified Files list; the alternative (new scriptblock wired post-cleanup in 86-loop-completion.ps1) touches more files and reorders the pipeline.

decision_atoms.statement: Use the real Set-Idea -Id <id> -Status 'held'|'decomposed' -Reason 'bridge-self-decomposition-invalid' API and treat the contract's Update-IdeaStatus / Set-IdeaHoldReason as aliases; guard every external call with Get-Command -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue.
decision_atoms.reason: Grep shows Update-IdeaStatus and Set-IdeaHoldReason do not exist anywhere; Set-Idea (lib/backlog-crud.ps1:381) is the canonical mutator and already accepts -Status and -Reason and is the function used to set 'held' across driver/81-loop-idle-claim.ps1. Set-Idea writes the reason onto the item, satisfying the hold-reason requirement in one call.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Deviates from the literal function names in the contract, which a naive reviewer might flag; mitigated by a comment mapping the contract names to Set-Idea and by Get-Command guards so a future rename or a stripped environment degrades gracefully instead of throwing.

decision_atoms.statement: Implement the gate as a pure-ish function that RETURNS a structured decision object; the cleanup call site applies the loop-scoped effects (suppress coder STATUS:CONTINUE on 'decomposed'; set $plannerStatus='CONTINUE' + force-retry flag on retry).
decision_atoms.reason: A PowerShell function has its own scope and cannot mutate the caller's $plannerStatus, unlike the existing critic scriptblock which is dot-sourced and shares scope. Returning a decision keeps the function unit-testable (mock Set-Idea/Read-State, assert on the returned object) and matches the contract's wording 'return a force-decompose-retry signal'.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Splits responsibility between function (durable side effects + decision) and call site (loop-var effects), so the wiring must be reviewed as a pair; the alternative of making the gate a dot-sourced scriptblock would share scope but be far harder to unit-test in isolation.

decision_atoms.statement: The predicate must load the full idea (Get-IdeaById) to compute AcceptanceCount/SubsystemCount/EstimatedTurns/Files for Test-IsLargeTask, and must independently exclude the 'bridge-self-child' tag.
decision_atoms.reason: Test-IsLargeTask for main/bridge returns true only via those counts (lib/prompt-builder.ps1:566-568); the contract's param set (id,tags,channel,scope,taskText) cannot produce them. prompt-builder.ps1:609-638 already shows the exact derivation to mirror. Test-IsLargeTask excludes 'atom'/'decomposed-child' but NOT 'bridge-self-child', so that tag must be filtered by the gate itself.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: Adds a backlog read inside the completion hot path; acceptable because it is read-only, already guarded, and only runs for main/bridge tasks. If the idea can't be loaded, fall back to the passed counts/params and fail the predicate closed (gate does nothing) rather than mis-firing.

decision_atoms.statement: Treat a missing, null, or parent-id-mismatched bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest as valid_split_count=0 with non-empty errors, routing to the retry/held path; never throw.
decision_atoms.reason: crusher-03 is a parallel wave-4 dependency and its state field is absent from the codebase today; the gate must not crash the completion loop when the field is missing. A 'last' (global) ingest can also belong to a previous parent, so verifying ingest.parent_id == current task id before trusting it prevents a stale ingest from falsely decomposing the wrong parent.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: If crusher-03's real schema differs from the assumed {created[], same_parent_skipped[], errors[], parent_id}, the count logic needs a small adapter; mitigated by isolating the extraction in one helper and coordinating the field schema explicitly with crusher-03.

decision_atoms.statement: Check retry_count BEFORE incrementing (0->'retry 1/3', 1->'2/3', 2->'3/3', then retry_count>=3 -> held) and reset bridge_self_decompose_retry_count + clear the ingest on any terminal outcome (decomposed or held).
decision_atoms.reason: This yields exactly 3 retries then held, matching the acceptance criteria, and the reset prevents the global counter from bleeding across different parent tasks (the next large parent would otherwise inherit a stale count and be held prematurely).
decision_atoms.tradeoff: The contract models the counter as a single global $state field; namespacing it per parent-id would be safer but exceeds 'medium' complexity, so the minimal version keeps it global but adds the terminal reset as the cheap contamination guard.

decision_atoms.statement: Wrap the entire gate (and its call site) in try/catch and never let it block DONE or set a failing planner status on its own internal error.
decision_atoms.reason: The existing call to Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh at cleanup:938 is already wrapped in try{}catch{}; a control-plane gate that can wedge the completion loop is exactly the 'false-green/dirty-guard' failure mode the project's critic lore warns about. A gate exception must degrade to 'noop'.
decision_atoms.tradeoff: A silently-swallowed gate error could let a bad parent slip to the coder once; mitigated by logging the catch to a crusher.log line and to Add-Message so the failure is visible rather than invisible.

assumptions: crusher-03 writes $state.bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest as an object exposing the created atoms and the same-parent-skipped atoms (each atom carrying a boolean valid_for_split), an errors array, and a parent_id; the gate counts atoms where valid_for_split==true across created + same-parent-skipped to get valid_split_count.
$PromptState is the object returned by Read-State, and state is mutated via Update-State { param($s) ... } (the established pattern in these files).
The 'CRUSHER: ...' log lines are surfaced via Add-Message -From system -Kind event (the project's visible-event convention) and optionally mirrored to a crusher.log file with UTF-8 encoding.

A sibling crusher task in the prompt-builder consumes the force-decompose-retry state flag (plus the stored ingest errors) to construct the retry prompt; this gate only sets the flag and the $plannerStatus, it does not itself build the prompt.

Writing status 'decomposed' is acceptable: Set-Idea does not validate status against an enum, and selectors only claim new/approved/held/running, so a 'decomposed' parent is automatically non-claimable (the desired 'kept away from the coder' effect).
The gate is only meaningful right after a decompose attempt completed in normal mode for the current parent; the cleanup call site already runs under modeBeforeIncrement-style normal-mode context.

risks.risk: crusher-03 (bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest) is not yet merged or uses a different field schema, so the gate reads a missing/incompatible structure.
risks.mitigation: Defensive extraction in one helper that returns valid_split_count=0 + synthetic error when the field is absent/null/parent-mismatched; this routes to the retry path safely. Coordinate the exact ingest schema (field names, parent_id) with crusher-03 before merge and add a schema-shape assertion in the selftest.

risks.risk: The contract's Files list names only actions.ps1, but the required invocation belongs in cleanup.ps1:938 — a reviewer enforcing the Files list literally could reject the cross-file edit.
risks.mitigation: Keep the function definition in actions.ps1 (honoring the named file), make the cleanup edit a single guarded line, and document in the commit/comment why the call site must live where Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh is actually invoked, citing the dot-source order in 86-loop-completion.ps1.

risks.risk: 'decomposed' is a new status not recognized by dashboards/counters (operator-pulse, batch rollups), so a decomposed parent may be invisible in status summaries.
risks.mitigation: Confirm selectors filter to known claimable statuses (they do) so 'decomposed' is correctly non-claimable; if visibility matters, also tag the idea (e.g. add a 'decomposed' tag) so existing tag-based views surface it, and verify no code path throws on an unknown status string.

risks.risk: Global $state.bridge_self_decompose_retry_count and the 'last' ingest are not keyed by parent id, so one parent's counters can contaminate another, causing premature held or a false decomposed.
risks.mitigation: Verify ingest.parent_id == current task id before trusting it; reset the retry counter and clear the ingest on every terminal outcome; in the advanced version, namespace both by parent id.

risks.risk: If the prompt-builder never honors the force-decompose-retry flag, the parent could loop until the 3-retry cap without making progress (wasted coder turns).
risks.mitigation: The hard 3-retry cap -> held is the backstop and must not be bypassable; assert in tests that the 4th invalid pass transitions to held, and emit a visible CRUSHER log each retry so a stuck loop is observable early.

risks.risk: Editing the file could drop the UTF-8 BOM or introduce a parse error, breaking PS 5.1 Cyrillic handling and the mandated parse/selftest/smoke checks.
risks.mitigation: Edit in place preserving BOM, run the ParseFile check and tools/test-loop-completion-decompose.ps1 (which asserts BOM + the fragments stay scriptblocks + Invoke-PostTaskSelfModelRefresh remains available), plus driver.ps1 -SelfTest, tools/smoke.ps1, and the canary before declaring done.

minimal_version: Add function Invoke-BridgeSelfDecomposeGate to driver/86-loop-completion-actions.ps1 taking -Id, -Tags, -Channel, -Scope, -TaskText, -PromptState. Predicate: channel=='main' AND scope=='bridge' AND tags exclude atom/decomposed-child/bridge-self-child AND Test-IsLargeTask returns true (load the idea via Get-IdeaById to pass AcceptanceCount/SubsystemCount/EstimatedTurns/Files, guarded). On FALSE, return {action='noop'}. On TRUE: read $PromptState.bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest, compute valid_split_count = count of valid_for_split==true across created + same-parent-skipped, read errors (missing/null/parent-mismatched ingest => count 0 + synthetic error). If valid_split_count>=2 AND errors empty: Set-Idea -Id -Status 'decomposed', reset retry counter + clear ingest, Add-Message 'CRUSHER: valid split N atoms, parent decomposed', return {action='decomposed'}. Else read bridge_self_decompose_retry_count (default 0): if >=3, Set-Idea -Id -Status 'held' -Reason 'bridge-self-decomposition-invalid', reset counter, Add-Message 'CRUSHER: retry exhausted, parent held', return {action='held'}; otherwise Update-State to increment the counter, store the ingest errors for the prompt, Add-Message 'CRUSHER: invalid split, retry N/3', return {action='force-decompose-retry', errors}. Insert one guarded call at cleanup.ps1 right after line 938: read state, derive the current task id/tags/channel/scope/taskText, call the gate; if action=='decomposed' do NOT emit the coder STATUS:CONTINUE; if action=='force-decompose-retry' set $plannerStatus='CONTINUE' and the force-retry state flag. Whole thing inside try/catch, all external calls Get-Command-guarded, BOM preserved. Passes ParseFile, driver.ps1 -SelfTest, tools/smoke.ps1, canary, and tools/test-loop-completion-decompose.ps1.
advanced_version: Everything in the minimal version, plus: (1) namespace bridge_self_decompose_retry_count and the ingest by parent id (e.g. a small map keyed by task id) with explicit parent-id match verification, eliminating cross-parent contamination entirely. (2) Add a dedicated selftest tools/test-crusher-decompose-gate.ps1 modeled on tools/diag/doctor-abort-requeue-selftest.ps1 that mocks Set-Idea, Test-IsLargeTask, Get-IdeaById and Read-State/Update-State to cover all six acceptance cases (non-main/non-bridge no-op, atom-tag pass-through, small-task no-op, valid>=2 decomposed with no CONTINUE, invalid+retry<3 increments + force-retry, invalid+retry>=3 held with reason), asserting on the returned decision object and the recorded side effects. (3) Emit a structured crusher.log line (ts, parent_id, valid_split_count, errors_count, action, retry_count) for offline auditing, in addition to the visible Add-Message. (4) Write an explicit coordination note/contract documenting the bridge_self_last_decompose_ingest schema agreed with crusher-03 (field names, valid_for_split semantics, parent_id, errors). (5) Make the gate idempotent: re-entry on an already-decomposed/held parent (detected by tag or status) is a guaranteed no-op so a resume/restart tail can't double-fire. (6) Add a lightweight metrics counter (decomposed/retried/held tallies) into state for the 24h verdict cycle to observe gate behavior over time.
